cache.canonical_boundary: Whole cache spelling must equal pyjson::dumps(parsed, pretty_sorted); embedded commit/record canonical representations equal unchanged constructors. Prospective image uses same decode path before publication. No parser/features/helpers changed.
cache.hlc: Exact original signed Commit.hlc string, including legacy accepted padding; numeric Hlc::parse only for monotonic comparison.
cache.monotonicity: Every prior positive author retained componentwise; exact same-slot originals/full record; increasing parsed HLC for a higher slot. Missing exact live/cache head or local record refuses without fallback.
cache.originals: Complete Commit::to_dict with original sig and full self-signed DeviceRecord::to_dict; canonical unsigned and signed bytes retained.
cache.vector: Exactly positive PyInt snapshot components; zero omitted; negative refused; sorted exact author heads.

new_fixed_StateError_reasons.team_compaction_head_limit_exceeded: Head/serialized cap or unsupported prospective cache depth under unchanged pyjson helper.
new_fixed_StateError_reasons.team_compaction_head_unavailable: Missing exact original or full local record; legacy loss has no synthesis/lower/newer fallback.
new_fixed_StateError_reasons.team_compaction_lock_required: Private helper without actual state lock.

non_effects: Cache never advances live vector or grants authority/admission/receipt/readiness.
HTTP gateway, separate SSH signer, all original wire/snapshot/record/numeric/crypto formats and supported CLI semantics unchanged.
Backup continues to omit cache; absent/corrupt cache grants nothing and cannot reconstruct lost originals.
Cache holds only original signed public/ciphertext evidence; no decrypt/private key/raw DEK/plaintext writes or new logs.
All M2-G01-G10, DOS-1 HIGH, Opus3eb interrupted, ca01275 and physical/Oracle/runtime/release holds remain OPEN.

private_api.PreparedHeads: Private fields/constructor; no Clone/Debug/Serialize/getter/public export; env/vector/total/state-path and exact snapshot image binding.
private_api.lock: Both helpers require actual StateDir::locked_by_current_thread(), no supplied Boolean/callback authority.
private_api.module: rust/src/team/compaction_heads.rs, private declaration only in team/mod.rs

real_compact.age_peer_gate: Original age cutoff/order/active-peer vector gate and result fields preserved. No-old/blocked attempts publish no cache and prune nothing.
real_compact.before_writes: All cache shape/signature/canonical/size/round-trip/coverage/regression checks finish before compact writes snapshot/cache.
real_compact.failure_meaning: Evidence refusal precedes new snapshot/cache/prune. Persistence failure can leave metadata, but no new unlink before completed barrier. Existing load_facts maintenance is not rolled back. No multi-file import transaction/journal claim.
real_compact.fresh_inputs: load_facts, CommitStore::all_commits, fold_with_snapshot for current membership; fact-free fold for full public signature records, including inactive/removed.
real_compact.lock_order: StateDir before fresh facts/commits/members; short envs lock for copied peer vectors and last_snapshot_total update. No disk/fold/network while holding envs in new compact path.
real_compact.mixed_commits: Any commit containing a retained kind remains live byte-identically; successful unlink counting unchanged.
